scope: Explain deterministic training in the README, and add the human and AI Test Index for choosing suites, reading evidence, and distinguishing bounded rule classes from individual patches.
Add D20 generation, native replay, scoring and a grouped study command. Retain a frozen seed, native outputs and large study counts with replay receipts.
validation: Native seed 20 produced one supported result in five expected positives and withheld all 15 single-owner controls. Two native executions produced identical JSON.
The 64-seed study ran 1,280 primary cases and 320 diagnostic replays. It withheld all 960 single-owner controls and identified three candidate rule classes.
Four D20 regression tests, the documentation audit covering 48 evaluation families, and the repository infrastructure check passed.
limitations: The public generator uses five authored structures. Seeds change identifiers and owners within those structures. Blind and historical transfer still require independently authored evaluations.
The raw sorter path measures candidate preprocessing only. The study changes no production rule and is not an application deployment.
next_steps: Trace and test narrow owner-question grammar, explicit record-alias binding and field-boundary rules independently. Keep all original D20 decisions and add independent negative controls before changing runtime behavior.
